·˚✿ POLLINATIONS WEEKLY ✿˚·
vol. 42 — 140 merged PRs. Infrastructure did its usual trick: becoming interesting only when it prevents an afternoon from disappearing.

The Responses API is now a first-class stateless route across text models: streaming, structured managed-agent output, and request examples included.

───

1. COMMUNITY MEDIA
Community models now cover embeddings, video, TTS, media categories, publishing, uptime in Play, and clearer health state. A model may now have ambitions beyond being a text box.

2. AGENTS + MCP
Managed agents gained tools and Responses output. Hosted MCP docs, Composio connectors, Pollinations MCP, and Open WebUI integration made existing toolchains less ceremonial to connect.

3. CATALOG + FALLBACKS
Popularity sorting, search filters, provider fallbacks, and additions including GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.8, and FLUX.2.

4. THE UNGLAMOROUS PART
Timeouts, stream semantics, pricing, schemas, fallback routing, and faster CI. The plumbing blinked first.

Docs: https://pollinations.ai/docs
Repo: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations

140 PRs merged. The repo is public; useful contributions remain welcome.
